# Init creates missing board files, preserves existing projection, and is repeatable.
exec weft$exe init
stdout 'existing WEFT.md was left unchanged'
cmp WEFT.md initial-projection.md
exists tasks/backlog tasks/todo tasks/doing tasks/done

exec weft$exe sync
stdout 'Synchronized WEFT.md'
grep '^# Weft$' WEFT.md
! cmp WEFT.md initial-projection.md

exec weft$exe init --json
json
stdout '"initialized": true'
stdout '"projection_updated": false'
exec weft$exe check --json
json
stdout '"ok": true'

exec weft$exe add 'Keep existing task' --state todo
cp tasks/todo/001-keep-existing-task.md task-before-init.md
exec weft$exe init --json
json
stdout '"projection_updated": false'
cmp tasks/todo/001-keep-existing-task.md task-before-init.md
exec weft$exe list todo --json
json
stdout '"title": "Keep existing task"'

-- WEFT.md --
# A manually maintained projection
-- initial-projection.md --
# A manually maintained projection
